from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLeaseData(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the financial report")
    lease_liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the lease liability")
    amount_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount, e.g. 'Yuan', 'Million Yuan', 'Thousand Yuan'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period of the financial report")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the lease liability information")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyLeaseData]
